data.name: Elemental Focus
data.description: The earth master can prepare one additional spell per day of each level she can cast, but it must have the earth descriptor. Preparing an air spell takes up two spell slots of the same level. You take a -4 penalty on any skill checks made when crafting a magic item that has an air spell as a prerequisite.
